auditVerdict: Existing-source audit complete; all reachable checks pass. Authenticated integration remains explicitly unverified.

criteria.criterion: React and Vite application are present and usable.
criteria.observed: Existing React 19.2.7 application builds with configured Vite 8.1.3. Real /welcome renders and its login link works. No second scaffold or dependency installation.
criteria.scope: Public application usability; not a successful business login.

criteria.criterion: A real data router supports the current application routes; observe direct URL, reload and back navigation rather than inferring from an import.
criteria.observed: 24 direct URL cases cover the current route patterns and fallback. All mount the React tree; 20 correctly stop at the installation-key boundary. /welcome -> /login preserves the document; reload creates a new document and keeps /login; Back restores /welcome. No page exceptions observed.
criteria.unverified: Authenticated screen bodies, actual role-derived navigation and API-dependent routing, owned by CCC-212 and existing frontend lane.

criteria.criterion: Existing shared design tokens and wire components are reused rather than copied into a new design system.
criteria.observed: @ccc/wire and contracts resolve inside the committed snapshot. The client build composes design/tokens.css, original web layout CSS and shared wireStyles. The public surface uses one emitted static stylesheet, no style tags, canonical 14px/32px variables, 24px card padding and 32px button height. 1280px and 390px light/dark observations show no horizontal overflow.
criteria.scope: Shared-source reuse and bounded public-surface verification, not a full design sweep.

criteria.criterion: The service worker caches only static assets and the app shell, never authenticated/API/PII responses or tokens. Observe real browser service-worker and cache behavior with non-sensitive synthetic inputs.
criteria.observed: Unchanged emitted /sw.js was manually registered in a fresh owned browser. Default-page CDP observations show activated control and exactly five cached files: app shell, web manifest, SVG icon, emitted JS and CSS. Seven real loopback synthetic dynamic responses, including Authorization-bearing requests and 401/POST cases, bypass worker handling. An Authorization/query-bearing static request returns byte-identical built JS without storing the marker. Cache keys and bodies remain static-only. With the actual origin stopped, three routes render from the worker, five asset hashes match the build, and all nine uncached requests reject. Web Storage, IndexedDB and cookies remain empty in this scenario.
criteria.scope: The generated worker itself and synthetic response boundaries are exercised. No live credential, real PII, fabricated authentication, signature bypass or real provider call.
criteria.unverified: Natural BusinessShell-triggered registration, authenticated reload/logout/revocation persistence, update waiting behavior and standalone OS installation are not established.

criteria.criterion: The existing design guard checks both apps/web and apps/client. Inspect actual guard inclusion and run the relevant supported guard without changing its rules, fixtures, baseline or assertions.
criteria.observed: Existing guard:tokens reads web layout CSS, shared wireStyles and client business.css, and scans apps/web/app, apps/client/src and packages/wire/src. The unmodified supported command exits 0 with token-audit: 위반 0.
criteria.scope: No guard rule, fixture, baseline or assertion changed. No duplicate full project suites.
